units: <cite ref="Pesachim 37a:8">Pes. 37ᵃ</cite> <he>אפשר … ויקבענה כ׳</he> he may form the dough in a mould and attach it to the cake directly (well fitting, without loss of time).

<cite ref="Mishnah Tamid 3:6">Tam. III, 6</cite> <he>אחד … ואחד פותח כ׳</he> (with one key) a priest puts his hand through an opening in the door (v. <cite ref="A01989"><he>אַמָּה</he></cite>), and another priest opens (with the other key) directly; (Talm. ed. 30ᵇ <he>ואחד שהוא פותח כ׳</he> and another key which opens directly).
<cite ref="Makkot 3a:7">Macc. 3ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>כ׳ שהגיד וכ׳</he> as soon as a witness has finished his evidence, he is not permitted to testify again (retract or modify).
<cite ref="Ketubot 11a:12">Keth. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>כ׳ שהגדילה וכ׳</he> as soon as she was of age for one while without protesting &c.
<cite ref="Eruvin 93b:12">Erub. 93ᵇ</cite> <he>כ׳ שהותרה הותרה</he> being once permitted (for one part of the Sabbath), it remains permitted; a. v. fr.
